description: Source code for font conversion utilities in the FreeType project, including functions for string to number conversions, decoding, and encoding of font data.

methods.name: PS_Conv_Strtol
methods.description: Converts a string to a long integer with specified base, handling overflow and sign.

methods.name: PS_Conv_ToInt
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer, handling optional '#' notation for base conversion.

methods.name: PS_Conv_ToFixed
methods.description: Converts a string to a fixed-point number, handling decimal, exponent, overflow, and underflow.

methods.name: PS_Conv_ASCIIHexDecode
methods.description: Decodes ASCII hex data into binary buffer, skipping whitespace.

methods.name: PS_Conv_EexecDecode
methods.description: Decodes eexec encrypted font data using a seed value.
